name: Burning Ground
definition: A damaging ground effect that deals fire damage over time. Burning ground is distinct from ignite; its damage depends on the source.

name: Unaffected
definition: The specified effect can still be present on you, but has no effect on you. This differs from immunity, which prevents or removes the specified effect.

name: Movement Speed
definition: Determines how fast an entity moves by running. Action speed is a separate modifier that also affects movement animations.

name: Fire Resistance
definition: Resistance applied to incoming fire damage, including hits and damage over time. The maximum resistance limits the benefit; resistance is distinct from damage reduction.

name: Cold Resistance
definition: Resistance applied to incoming cold damage, including hits and damage over time. Its benefit is limited by maximum resistance.

name: Lightning Resistance
definition: Resistance applied to incoming lightning damage, including hits and damage over time. Its benefit is limited by maximum resistance.

name: Chaos Resistance
definition: Resistance applied to incoming chaos damage. Elemental resistance modifiers do not grant chaos resistance; modifiers to all resistances include it.

name: Elemental Resistance
definition: A modifier to elemental resistances affects fire, cold and lightning resistance. It does not affect chaos resistance.

name: Recently
definition: Refers to the past four seconds.

name: Critical Strike
definition: A hit whose damage is multiplied by the critical strike multiplier. Damage over time does not hit and cannot critically strike.

name: Armour
definition: A defence that reduces physical damage from hits. Its effectiveness depends on the size of the physical hit relative to your armour; it does not reduce physical damage over time.

name: Life
definition: The health resource of a character or monster. Reaching zero life normally causes death.

name: Maximum Life
definition: The upper limit of the life resource before effects such as reservation. This is distinct from your current amount of life.

name: Stun
definition: An interruption caused by a hit that briefly stops an entity from acting. Stun chance depends on the hit damage relative to the target’s stun threshold.

name: Stun Threshold
definition: The effective life value against which hit damage is compared when determining stun chance. Reducing an enemy’s stun threshold makes a given hit more likely to stun.

name: Physical Damage
definition: One of the five damage types. Armour mitigates physical damage from hits; it does not mitigate physical damage over time such as bleeding.

name: Attack Speed
definition: Affects how quickly attack skills are performed. Most attacks derive their base attack time from the equipped weapon; action speed is a separate factor.

name: Cast Speed
definition: Affects how quickly spells are cast. Increasing cast speed reduces cast time; this does not by itself reduce a skill’s cooldown.

name: Energy Shield
definition: A defence that generally absorbs damage before life and can recharge after a period without taking damage. Special mechanics can bypass or change how it protects life.

name: Evasion
definition: A defence checked against an attacker’s accuracy to determine whether an attack hit is evaded. It does not evade spell hits.

name: Buff Effect
definition: Changes the strength of the applicable buff’s effects. The modifier must specify which buff or buffs it affects.

name: No Reservation
definition: The specified skill reserves none of its usual resource. This does not by itself change other costs of the skill.

name: Reservation
definition: Sets aside part of a resource, usually mana or life, while an ongoing skill is active. The reserved portion is unavailable for other uses; reservation does not lower the resource’s maximum.
